status: PROSPECTIVE RULE INPUT for GRAPH_CLASSIFICATION_V1_2. Registered before any holdout fixture for the rule was written. Non-authoritative: it decides only which shared identifiers are insufficient by themselves to ground an economic connection candidate.
policy: Owner policy 2026-10-22: generic shared identifiers (regulators, exchanges, generic institutional roles) are insufficient by themselves to establish an economic connection candidate.

entity_types.rationale: A regulator touches every regulated firm and product; sharing one says nothing about a specific economic link.
A shared country, region or market area is a background condition, not a link between two economic objects.

identifier_prefixes.rationale: ISO 10383 market identifier codes name trading venues, which every listed security on them shares.
ISO 3166 country and subdivision codes are geographies.

does_not_cover: Generic institutions recorded with an ordinary entity type and identifier (for example a central bank, court, tax authority or standard setter recorded as LEGAL_ENTITY with an LEI) are NOT recognised unless typed REGULATOR or listed here by exact identifier after owner review.
Names never decide genericness, and no entity is treated as generic from its label.
A documented relationship involving a generic institution, or the same document cited by both records, still grounds a candidate.
